Detailed Description

Set of event handler functions, one function to handle each possible event happened. Handlers are grouped into a struct to facilitate passing them as a single parameter to the install and remove handlers functions of the event loop. Event handlers are optional and if not set for a given event, that event will be silently ignored.

◆ name

std::string beerocks::EventLoop::EventHandlers::name

A common name for all handlers which will be associated with the EventLoop registered file descriptor.

◆ on_disconnect

EventHandler beerocks::EventLoop::EventHandlers::on_disconnect

Hook method that is called back by the event loop to handle disconnect events. Disconnect events are dispatched for example when the remote socket is closed.

◆ on_error

EventHandler beerocks::EventLoop::EventHandlers::on_error

Hook method that is called back by the event loop to handle error events. Error events are dispatched for example when an error occurs while waiting for a socket to be ready for a read or write operation.

◆ on_read

EventHandler beerocks::EventLoop::EventHandlers::on_read

Hook method that is called back by the event loop to handle read events. Read events are dispatched for example when a socket is ready for a read operation (a read operation will not block).

◆ on_write

EventHandler beerocks::EventLoop::EventHandlers::on_write

Hook method that is called back by the event loop to handle write events. Write events are dispatched for example when a socket is ready for a write operation (a write operation will not block).
